title: Acceptance from a Live Configuration
statement: For a nondeterministic register machine $A$, oracle, input $x$, control state $l$, and register valuation $v$, a configuration with state $l$, valuation $v$, and no recorded answer has an accepting run if and only if there is a choice bit $b$ such that the configuration after one step using $b$ has an accepting run.
hypotheses_covered: state l and register valuation v
